body:
Pet decision 1 (29 Oct) says sickness ships with the vet in "update 2", so a sick pet can always be cured.
On 30 Oct you made it one Pets and Farm Update (stages 1-6). No stage holds sickness or the vet yet.
The game has no vet today (checked GitHub main, stamp 2026102902).
Pick one:
A) Sickness + vet go in this update. Plan picks the stage.
B) Both wait for a later update. Pets get sad, never sick, for now.

comments.text: Sickness and vets in this update! Need models for vet station and mechanics. SEND URGENT MSG TO PLAN

Game rules chat: Recorded: sickness and the vet go in this update. Urgent row sent to Plan. Models: the vet person (Living chat) and the vet station with its inside (Non-living chat) are already ordered, 3 versions each for your pick. Sick-pet looks sent to Model movements. Mechanics: drafts 'How a vet visit works' and 'How pets get sick' are in Game rules for your OK. One new question: a vet job for players.

short: Sickness and the vet are in this update
source: chat 30 Oct 2026: Game rules chat found pet decision 1 clashes with the one-update plan
title: Sick pets and the vet: in this update (decided 30 Oct)
